notes.title: August 10th Patch Notes
notes.content: We have noticed that some players playing the game while offline have caused cloud data to become unsynchronized, leading to some misunderstandings. We have added notifications to clarify this and introduced status checks. We recommend that players play the game while online.

notes.title: Simple optimization
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that the stone picture does not display and the full unlock button does not display text.
2. Optimization: [After clicking the full unlock button, you need to re-enter this level to take effect]. Instead, it takes effect immediately.

notes.title: Experience Update : Avatar Display + Profile Lookup
notes.content:
Optimized some artwork.
 You can now see your avatar in the leaderboard.
 You can now directly click on leaderboard players to view their profiles.

notes.title: Major Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where the leaderboard could only store data for one level.
We apologize to the players for the oversight during launch testing that caused this bug.

notes.title: Fix startup errors
notes.content:
1.Added tutorial
2. Fixed the bug that the game cannot be played when starting in non-Chinese or English languages.
3. Adjust the values ​​to make the early stage easier
